verifications.notes: The Edit action accepts a full Customer model and persists it without any ownership or allow‑list checks. No role or ownership guard is visible in the provided code.
TryUpdateModel binds all request parameters to the Customer entity, and there is no visible ownership or allow‑list enforcement before saving.
User::create($request->all()) uses a model with $guarded = [], allowing all attributes—including 'role'—to be mass‑assigned. No server‑side role assignment or guard is present.
Team::create($request->all()) allows 'owner_id' to be set via the request. No server‑side assignment of the current user’s ID is performed.
User.findByIdAndUpdate(req.user._id, req.body, ...) updates the user document with the entire request body, exposing all fields to client manipulation. No allow‑list or role guard is visible.
